interface.longDescription: Paper workflow: read papers + cast cards in one go. Takes one or more arxiv links, paper URLs, PDFs, or paper names. For each paper, runs ljg-paper (generates org analysis) then ljg-card -v (generates visual sketchnote PNG). Use when user says '论文流', 'paper flow', '读论文并做卡片', '论文卡片', or provides multiple papers wanting both analysis and cards.
